notes.title: Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
Ping a friend and play multiplayer using Steam's built in Remote Play feature!  This cool feature allows you to play Extrorb's awesome local multiplayer mode with [i]any[/i] of your Steam friends, even if they don't also own the game.

[b]Setup[/b]
Once you have it running, the remote friend should have their controller set to Controller 2 and then set your controller to Controller 1.  Whomever is Player 1 can choose to still use the keyboard, but Player 2 will always need to be set to Controller 2.

[b]Connection/Lag[/b]
This whole setup really depends on your internet connection and the Steam software to run correctly.  Try to select a lower stream quality option if you experience lag on the remote computer.

notes.title: Review Drive for DLC!
notes.content:
We want to add more content!  But first, we need to know you guys are actually playing!  If we can get at least 10 reviews this week we'll drop our next DLC level for everyone!  Let [i]us[/i] know what you think by letting [i]others[/i] know what you think!  If you have any suggestions for a specific theme for the next level send that our way also and we would love to try and make that happen.

Thank you to everyone who has been enjoying the game so far!

-Nick

notes.title: Did someone misplace an axe?
notes.content:
We've conjured up something interesting to keep you [i]on the edge[/i] of your seat this Halloween!  Let's see how well you can slip past this crazy contraption and still find your way to your target.

No purchase necessary, this new level will be added to your list [i]for free[/i] when you update to the latest version.

notes.title: Welcome to the Graveyard...
notes.content:
We've added a [b]COMPLETELY FREE[/b], spooky new level to kick off October, with a few tricks and treats to get you excited for Halloween!

Graveyard is a chilling new level where not everything is as it seems.  Pumpkins stare at you menacingly, and something gooey emits a bright green glow from within the open graves.  What are those lights in the distance?    

[i]Maybe don't get too close to the pumpkins...[/i]

Keep a close eye over the next few weeks as we add even more free content!

notes.title: Full camera control!
notes.content:
We've added the ability to fully control the camera via mouse or game controller for even greater player control.  We've also enabled a portrait orientation mode!

For additional personal preferences, first and second player can invert their view control within settings.

[i]Note: The HMI is optimized for landscape orientation, but some players have requested the ability to run this in portrait (we're looking at you home pinball machine owners).[/i]
